test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Ravi sells his goods at a 25% loss on cost price but uses 45% less weight. What is his percentage profit or loss?
solution:
Given:

Loss% (a) = 25%

Less weight (b) = 45%

Formula Used:

Profit% / Loss% = (b ± a) / (100 - b) × 100
